d.d: A member of a tribe of Native Americans currently residing in northeastern Nebraska and western Iowa.
A country in West Asia in the Middle East. Official name: Sultanate of Oman. Capital: Muscat.
A person from Oman or of Omani descent.
Of, from, or pertaining to Oman or the Omani people.

A glacial erratic piece of (typically smooth) dark siliceous greywacke that exhibits a hemispherical pit or hole (as a result of selective dissolution of carbonate concretions within the greywacke), originating in the Omarolluk Formation and carried by glaciers throughout Canada and the United States.
